prompt: Create a full-body chibi character illustration of a cute but sinister young girl named Olivia, the Cursed Doll. She has long, messy blonde hair with dark red butterfly clips on either side. Her large blue eyes are wide and manic, with blood splatters around them. She wears a black gothic lolita dress with puffy sleeves, a corset-style bodice with red lacing, and a jagged, torn hemline stained with blood. In her right hand, she holds a bloody dagger pointing downwards. She wears black lace-up boots. Surrounding her are three small, ghostly white spirits with glowing red eyes and two dark butterflies. The background is plain white with scattered red blood splatters and ink blots. Include handwritten text in the bottom right corner that reads '呪いの人形' and 'Olivia'.
